title: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer For Lawyers & Compliance Officers | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer For Lawyers & Compliance Officers. Category: Development. Duration: 10 months. Description: Designed for lawyers, compliance officers, auditors, and regulatory professionals to understand AI, blockchain, and digital asset ecosystems, including interpreting smart contracts. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
